title: The method list (header)
description: method-list.json: the two method documents in one signed file. The header is checked here; the nested documents keep their own schemas and loaders: `catalogue` is data/method-catalogue/catalogue.json's schema_version 2 (src-app/server/src/modules/method_catalogue/types.rs) and `images` is src-app/server/data/method-env-images.schema.json's schema_version 2. Written by scripts/assemble-method-list.py (sorted keys, indent 1), checked by scripts/check-method-list.sh, signed with minisign by scripts/publish-method-list.sh (trusted comment `txresbench-method-list format=<format_version> sequence=<sequence>`), loaded by src-app/server/src/modules/method_list/. Any change to this header or to either nested schema is a new format_version, published under a new tag line (v2, v3).

format_version.description: The format line. The app refuses another one (it needs a newer app).

sequence.description: Each list is the previous one + 1; the app keeps the valid list with the highest sequence. 0 = the unsigned bootstrap copy an app release carries until the first publish.

assembled_at.description: When the list was assembled (UTC, from SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH when set).

catalogue.description: The catalogue, schema_version 2, as written by scripts/method-catalogue/gen_method_catalogue.py.

images.description: The environment images list, schema_version 2, as written by scripts/generate-method-env-images.py.
